headline: Google staff join protest over AI in school search
pages: More than 550 Google employees have signed a petition asking the company to let schools use Search without AI. Parents and educators protested outside Google offices in six cities last week with the same request. The backlash began after Google said it would not unbundle AI from its education tools. NPR's Sequoia Carrillo reports that angry parents and state and national lawmakers are pushing back. Google got two earlier court cases dismissed by arguing AI Overviews and Search are one tool, which may make separating them legally difficult. Google would not comment to NPR. The union for Google workers says the stance could hurt the company's reputation with students and teachers.
Some districts are looking at workarounds such as browser extensions. Source: NPR.
